$comment: Repository-owned dependency policy. An authority for the canonical owner-debt import graph, hashed into its producer-input identity alongside package.json, package-lock.json and dependency-cruiser.config.cjs. Its purpose is to make an existing architectural fact machine-readable: some packages are deliberately NOT installed by an ordinary `npm ci`, are loaded dynamically at the point of use, and must therefore never be followed from ambient node_modules. Without this file the graph generator cannot distinguish an intentional optional external from an accidental undeclared import, so whether a developer happened to run `npm install` decided the identity of a committed artifact.

@pulumi/gcp.reason: GCP distributed-test provisioning; loaded dynamically only when provision() runs, so an ordinary checkout imports the provisioner without it
